lineas.texto: Why does a pen stop writing when you hold it upside down?
A ballpoint pen has no pump inside.
Gravity pulls the ink down, right against the little ball.
Turn it upside down, and the ink slides away from the tip.
Air sneaks in behind the ball, and the line goes dry.
Space pens fix it with gas packed in behind the ink.
The gas pushes the ink onto the ball, in any direction.
They write upside down, underwater, even in zero gravity.
